sections.Profile:
"Check," "Check Mate," and "Jake Mate" are variations of an electro-mechanical pinball machine series produced by Recel S. A.

- Manufacturer: Recel S. A.
- Years made: 1974–1975
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 1
- Tags: Single Player, Multi Theme, Horses, Original Theme, Chess, 1970s, Games
